trial_fit_notes: Optional male/female test samples reproduce the basket joints and are not assembly parts
A 0.35 mm nominal clearance per side requires actual printing checks
T sockets are intentionally open at both Z ends; do not add floors or stops
Slide vertically without bending or snapping the tongue
Support the whole ring from beneath when carrying; vertical removal is intentional

integral_joint.type: Vertical through T-slot, integral with each basket
integral_joint.male_side: Sector end / clockwise basket at shared boundary
integral_joint.female_side: Sector start / counterclockwise basket at shared boundary
integral_joint.installation: Lower a basket vertically; both ends of the socket are open so the final basket can close the ring
integral_joint.removal: Lift the selected basket at least 23 mm before moving it sideways; remove sorter docking pins first
integral_joint.function: Horizontal alignment of floor-standing bins; support all bases while carrying
integral_joint.print_supports: None for vertical joint; 0.25 mm end relief over 0.65 mm height

central_integral_joint.type: Three radial T keys on central case into basket inner-wall vertical sockets
central_integral_joint.installation: Remove the sorter; close the basket ring; align all three keys and lower the central case vertically
central_integral_joint.removal: Lift the central case at least 22 mm before moving it sideways
central_integral_joint.print_supports: None; vertical joints and 45 degree outer bowl flare
central_integral_joint.function: Horizontal alignment only; support the entire base when carrying
